scope: Audited the remaining Section 18 gates against committed local evidence and a fresh offline acceptance run. No paid calls or asset downloads were used.

checks.backend_tests: fail: TimeoutExpired at the configured 1200-second suite timeout

acceptance_report.hosted_ci: not observed; not queried under the local-tools-only constraint
acceptance_report.external_connection_telemetry: not instrumented by the acceptance runner; offline profile and source_integrity were used

research_gate.result: BECCSV full baseline and six ablations remain declared_not_executed. The local Ollama manifests/blobs are inventoried, but the Ollama loopback service was inaccessible and the repository has no BECCSV inference/ablation executor. The available ASR matched-ablation report is a different experiment and is not counted as BECCSV evidence.
research_gate.remedy: Provide an available local inference runtime and implement/run the frozen BECCSV baseline and ablation executor; preserve all failures and calculate consultation-level uncertainty.

engineering_gate.result: Fresh acceptance failed: backend suite timed out and frontend build could not start. Hosted CI exact-commit result was not observed.
engineering_gate.remedy: Resolve the backend suite timeout, provide Node/npm locally, rerun clean exact-commit acceptance, then obtain hosted CI status.

product_gate.result: Synthetic application walkthrough passed, but complete scripted persona journeys and recovery/fallback E2E could not be established because the backend suite timed out and frontend build runtime was unavailable.
product_gate.remedy: Run the complete product E2E suite with the local browser toolchain and preserve per-journey receipts.

clinical_evidence_gate.result: No qualified independent reviewers, independently accepted labels, institutional owner, or privacy approvals are available in this workspace.
clinical_evidence_gate.remedy: Qualified reviewers and institutional/privacy approvals must be supplied by the project owner; no clinical release is authorized.

provenance_binding_implementation.test_command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_experiment_contract.py tests/test_experiment_receipts.py tests/test_beccsv_experiment_lock.py tests/test_artifact_provenance.py
provenance_binding_implementation.result: Receipt and acceptance helpers validate commit, dataset, model/config digest fields and locked experiment inputs. This does not prove every repository experiment/test has a complete receipt.

fresh_unmodified_acceptance.result: The required clean exact-commit run was performed from unmodified inputs with offline profile and source hashes; the acceptance did not finish green because backend tests timed out and frontend build runtime was absent.

prototype_score_gate.result: No 10/10 internal prototype label is issued: engineering and product gates are not green. Clinical 10/10 is not claimed.

missing_evidence_fail_closed.result: Missing evidence is represented as blocked/unknown, and the clinical release gate remains closed.

runtime.network_policy: local loopback only for application tests; hosted CI not queried
